subject: Medford Family Network
overview: Host Danielle Balocca provided an update on proposed city budget measures before interviewing Medford Family Network representatives about the organization's history, community programming, equity outreach, and upcoming fundraising gala.

items.title: City Budget Proposals Update
items.summary: Danielle Balocca outlined competing proposals to address the city budget, including the Mayor's $3 million tax levy plan and a $12 million Proposition 2.5 override proposed by Councilors Zach Bears and Kit Collins.

items.title: Medford Family Network History and Operations
items.summary: Marie Cassidy and Caroline Cohen described how the Medford Family Network was established, its transition to include an advisory board and a 501(c)(3) fundraising arm, and its role in connecting local parents.

items.title: Equity Initiatives and Cummings Foundation Grant
items.summary: The guests detailed plans to expand outreach to underserved communities and announced a $100,000 Cummings Foundation grant over three years to fund additional staffing and targeted programming.

items.title: Night Under 10,000 Lights Gala
items.summary: Caroline Cohen announced that the annual fundraising gala will take place at Wright's Pond on September 10th to raise funds for summer programming.
